subject: Onboarding timer pause request — procurement delay
messages:
From: Samantha Reyes <samantha@orchidhealth.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Orchid Health Purchasing <procurement@orchidhealth.com>
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Onboarding timer pause request — procurement delay

Hi Tessa,

Hope you’re well. Quick heads-up from our side: our procurement team has routed the PO for the pilot but it hit an internal three-step review and won’t clear until next Tuesday (est. 3 business days). The pilot onboarding timer is currently at day 11 of 14 and we’re worried about losing momentum if the environment shuts off before the PO clears.

Can Redwood pause the trial countdown for 5 days or provide a short-term token cushion so our engineers can finish the integration tests while the PO is processed? We’d rather avoid restarting the onboarding window — it’s expensive for our team.

I can share the PO stub and a short authorization email from procurement if that helps speed approval.

Appreciate any flexibility you can offer.

— Samantha
Samantha Reyes
Head of Data Integration, Orchid Health
phone: (415) 555-0198

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Reyes <samantha@orchidhealth.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 10:01:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onboarding timer pause request — procurement delay

Hi Samantha — thanks for the heads-up and for offering to share the PO stub.

We can absolutely help avoid an onboarding interruption. I’ll propose a short, conditional accommodation while finance confirms the incoming PO:

- Pause the trial timer for 5 calendar days OR
- Provide a 5,000-token temporary credit (whichever you prefer) to keep the environment live while the PO clears.

If you can attach the PO stub and any procurement confirmation, I’ll loop in finance and operations for formal sign-off. I’m cc’ing Camila (account lead) and David (billing ops) so we can approve quickly.

Let me know which option you prefer (timer pause vs token cushion) and I’ll move this through internally.

Best,
Tessa
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 13:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding timer pause request — procurement delay

Tessa — I reviewed the context and support a small safety net here. Approving the 5-day onboarding pause and the 5,000-token temporary credit for Orchid Health. Rationale: mid-market POC, strong signals from product team, low economic risk and high likelihood of conversion.

Actions for David:
- Please create voucher RDW-ORCHID-TEMP-5000 and set expiry to 2027-06-05.
- Mark the HubSpot record (linked below) with an "Onboarding pause — PO in flight" note and attach the PO stub when received.

David — can you confirm once voucher is issued and update billing so we don’t accidentally invoice for the tokens used under the trial?

Thanks — I’ll stand by for the external confirmation and the PO stub.

Camila
Camila Reyes
Senior Solutions Manager, Redwood Inference

Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 14:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding timer pause request — procurement delay

Hi Samantha — quick update and confirmation.

Thanks for sending the PO stub this morning (attached). Per internal approvals, we’ve issued the temporary accommodation as requested:

- Trial timer paused for 5 days (pause effective immediately).
- A 5,000-token voucher has been created as a fallback: code RDW-ORCHID-TEMP-5000 (expires 2027-06-05).

Attachments: signature_sheet.pdf (consent form placeholder) — we’ll add the PO when you forward the final copy.

If anything changes on your end (PO clears earlier or you’d prefer tokens instead of the pause), just reply and we’ll adjust. I’ve also added a note to HubSpot (link below) and asked billing to ensure no unexpected charges during the pause.

All the best — good luck with the integration tests.

Tessa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
phone: (650) 555-0124
